name: ORM parameterization eliminates SQLi false positive

input.title: User input flows into Django ORM .filter(username=...) — alleged SQLi
input.summary: Semgrep flagged user input reaching a Django ORM filter as 'sql-injection'. The ORM emits parameterized SQL; no string interpolation occurs.
input.root_cause: Scanner false positive — ORM emits parameterized query

rationale: ORM emits prepared statements. Scanner can't tell; technical verifier confirms parameterized SQL by inspecting the generated cursor.
